requirements.item_text: Procedures are in place for the safe removal of waste, including toxic chemical and biological waste, reagents, samples, solvents and air filters.

mappings.quote: Procedures should be in place for the safe removal of types of waste including toxic waste (chemical and biological), reagents, samples, solvents and air filters.

requirements.item_text: Antimicrobial waste from laboratory testing is taken into account in exceptional cases, for example when a quality control laboratory tests very large sample quantities.

mappings.quote: The amount of antimicrobial waste being generated by laboratory testing activities is generally considered to be negligible compared to the amounts that are being generated by manufacturing activities but should still be considered in exceptional cases, e.g. if very large amounts of sample are being tested by a quality control laboratory.

requirements.item_text: Manufacturers of active substances and finished products consider keeping a risk assessment of all contaminants from antimicrobial manufacturing should they reach the environment, including the risk of resistant microorganisms developing.

mappings.quote: manufacturers of APIs and FPPs should consider retaining documentation on the following: ■■ a risk assessment for all contaminants related to antimicrobial manufacturing, in the event that they are released into the environment, and the associated risk of development of resistant microorganisms

requirements.item_text: Based on the environmental risk assessment, active substance and finished product sites consider keeping a waste-stream analysis for each antimicrobial they produce.

mappings.quote: based on the above risk assessment, waste-stream analysis for each antimicrobial agent produced (at API sites and FPP sites).
This analysis should be repeated whenever there is a change in production affecting waste streams
mappings.addendum: The waste-stream analysis is repeated whenever a production change affects waste streams.

requirements.item_text: Manufacturers consider keeping records of the amount and nature of waste generated, including analytical data and documented analyses and findings on levels of antimicrobials or their precursors.

mappings.quote: the quantity and nature of the waste generated, including the analytical data and documentation of analyses performed and their findings on the levels of antimicrobial agents or their precursors

requirements.item_text: The methods used to treat antimicrobial waste are documented as effective for each specific antimicrobial or antimicrobial precursor.

mappings.quote: information on the methods used to treat the waste should be documented to be effective for each specific antimicrobial or antimicrobial precursor.
Analytical data demonstrating the conversion of these substances and their residues to non-hazardous waste materials should be available at the facility and kept up to date
mappings.addendum: Analytical data showing that these substances and their residues are converted to non-hazardous waste are kept at the site and up to date.

requirements.item_text: Where effective treatment is not yet in place for all waste streams from each active substance or finished product, a documented time-limited strategy with set milestones describes the actions towards treatment that significantly lowers the concentration of the antimicrobial or its precursor, and of its microbial source where relevant.

mappings.quote: if effective waste treatment is not yet implemented for all waste streams resulting from the manufacture of each API or FPP, documentation on a time-limited strategy should be in place, with specified milestones for that implementation, specifying actions towards achieving treatment that significantly reduces the concentration of the antimicrobial substance or its precursor (and its microbial source, when relevant)

requirements.item_text: Manufacturers consider keeping a rationale and risk assessment explaining their choice of decontamination methods for manufacturing waste containing antimicrobials and/or their mitigation strategy.

mappings.quote: a rationale and risk assessment as to why the manufacturer selected specific methods of decontamination of manufacturing waste containing antimicrobials and/or their mitigation strategy
The level of effectiveness and by-products should be considered when adopting a particular approach.
mappings.addendum: The effectiveness and by-products of a treatment approach are considered when it is chosen.

requirements.item_text: Incineration may be considered as a treatment for solid or semi-liquid waste.

mappings.quote: Incineration may also be considered for solid or semi-liquid waste.

requirements.item_text: A zero-liquid-effluent or zero-discharge approach is adopted, especially where the environmental risk is assessed as high or unclear.

mappings.quote: The zero-liquid effluent approach or zero-discharge policy is encouraged, especially when the risk is assessed to be high or unclear, as it prevents any contamination of the environment.

requirements.item_text: Waste-related documentation is kept at the manufacturing site, even where an external contractor is used.

mappings.quote: It is recommended that this documentation be maintained at the manufacturing facility regardless of whether or not an external contractor has been used.

requirements.item_text: Manufacturers consider keeping periodic reports on how waste and wastewater are collected, treated and disposed of, at a frequency set by risk and consistent with any applicable local, regional or international regulatory requirements.

mappings.quote: regular reports on the collection, treatment and disposal of waste and wastewater; the frequency should be risk-based and in line with local, regional or international regulatory requirements, as applicable
